reaLimit: Existing metadata inspection was partial because of the 64 MiB parser limit; no duplicate inspection performed.
analysis: ILSpy execution-free targeted decompilation against the installed binary; runtime validation is delegated to the parent task.

entrypoints.observation: Maps current document sitemap nodes to Id/Name/Type/Children using stable page package GUIDs.
Native main client page loading/switch entry; GUID argument identifies the page package. CLI passes Guid.Empty,false for remaining arguments and checks active KE5 afterward.

Native tree AddNode edit. TSDA sets insertion index; pSDd sets package GUID; tSDy supplies a detached QJlk created with the native constructor and OJl6(Tree); tSDY supplies initial name. Native AddNode numbering always appends a suffix, so an additional lSDD RenameNode edit is combined with AddNode using native BS11.pS1H.

Native workspace dispatcher passes the compound AddNode+RenameNode edit to client.CImW. CgQ calls edit.Commit and records one native undo item. pS1H commits children in order and rolls them back in reverse; RenameNode sets the exact requested name via HJvI.XIwn.

undoObservation: lSDD reverse path SSDi captures PtdG metadata and removes the package; subsequent Commit restores captured metadata and tree node. CLI intentionally leaves active page unchanged for this workspace history entry.
scope: Root-level page creation, sitemap listing and page opening only. No mouse or keyboard events, no app launch/attach/stop in this research scope.
limits: Version/hash pinned; future builds unsupported until mapped.
Page names are trimmed; existing page/folder names are rejected case-insensitively before mutation.
Page creation leaves original page selected; page.open explicitly switches to the returned page Id.
Parent observed original page create/open/undo/redo pass; exact-name compound update still requires parent runtime acceptance.
